summary:
Highly accomplished computer science professor with over 20 years of experience teaching at the
university level, seeking a full time position which is research and industry oriented to enable improve
technological standards in overall learning community. Demonstrated excellence in teaching and
research, and a strong commitment to student success.

education.raw_text: PhD Gujarat University, Department of Computer Science April 2020 Title: “An Innovative Framework for Remote Database Experimentation” MCA IGNOU (Indira Gandhi National Open University), Computer Science May 2007

experience.raw_text:  Department of Computer Science, Gujarat University, Ahmedabad, Gujarat
August 2011 – Present
o Provided comprehensive academic support to the head of the Department of Computer Science.

o Taught MCA(Masters of Computer Application students) – masters course averaging 40 students per semester covering following topics: Database Management Systems, Java Programming and Full stack Development Bhumika Shah - 1

o Taught M.Sc(Masters in Science-Computer Science) students) – undergraduate course averaging 120 students per semester covering following topics: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Database management system and Front end web development.
o Developed quizzes, exams, and homework
o Revised the syllabus to meet accreditation standards
o Designed the new syllabus as per the new education policy (NEP 2020)
o Served as a student counselor (mentor) for incoming freshman students.
o Designed syllabi for the M.Sc. course, specializing in subjects like Database Management Systems, Java Programming, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and more.
o Represented the department at international conferences and academic events, fostering networking and collaboration opportunities.
o Organized state and national-level workshops, seminars, and events to enhance the learning experience of students.
o Deliver engaging lectures and tutorials for both undergraduate and graduate students, employing effective teaching methodologies.
o Actively involved in writing research funding proposals, contributing to the department's research initiatives.
o Provide guidance and mentorship to project students, assisting them with their dissertations and project work.
o Oversee the entire placement process for graduating batches, ensuring successful career opportunities for students.
